---
title: "Instructions to export a Smart PDF"
author: "Zach Barrett"
date: last-modified
---
---

This procedure tells you how to make a _Smart PDF_ of an Altium design.
Do the steps in the given sequence.


1.  In the menu bar, select "File".
    Then select "Smart PDF".

    ![](../../assets/smartpdf/files-smart-pdf.png)

2.  Press "Next" until the "Export Bill of Materials" page comes into view.

3.  Clear the "Export a Bill of Materials" checkbox.

    ![](../../assets/smartpdf/export-bom.png)

4.  Press "Next" to go to the "PCB Printout Settings" page.

5.  Select the "Holes" checkbox.

    ![](../../assets/smartpdf/pcb-printout-settings.png)

6.  Press "Next" to go to the "Additional PDF Settings" page.

7.  Make sure that "PCB Color Mode" is set to "Color".

    ![](../../assets/smartpdf/additional-pdf-settings.png)

8.  Press "Next" to go to the "Structure Settings" page.

9.  Do not change the "Structure Settings" page.
    Press "Next".

10. On the "Final Steps" page, clear the "Save Settings to Output Job
    Document" checkbox.

    ![](../../assets/smartpdf/final-steps.png)

11. Press "Finish".

12. Wait until the Smart PDF opens in the default browser (Edge).

13. In the top right corner, select "Save As".

14. Save the file in a location that you can find again.
    For example, save the file on the desktop.

Submit this document to Canvas when you submit an Altium design.
Examples of these designs are project one, project two, and the midterm
assessment.
